scope.summary: Integrate Tailor garments, bodies, materials, recipes, captures, references, DCC reports, and mix graphs with Loom/Notes/ProjectKnowledgeIndex through stable shared references, backlinks, tags, search, and navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Consumes only shared Loom/Notes/ProjectKnowledgeIndex interfaces registered by their owning pillars; absent or incompatible owner interfaces return the typed LoomInteropUnavailable contract with owner/interface/version/retry fields, never a Tailor-private index, navigation API, or knowledge authority. Loom stores links and knowledge metadata, not duplicate Tailor payload authority; direct-load by stable ref precedes semantic search.
Backlinks, tags, notes, navigation, rename/version/tombstone/missing-asset, capability-denied, and no-silent-auto-index behavior are typed and tested.
Uses the shared navigation and primitive/index schemas; bounded Tailor domain graphs declare their ownership and remain cross-navigable.
scope.risk_if_missed: Duplicated assets or a Tailor-only knowledge browser would drift from Loom and strand production context.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI contract: typed commands, state, receipts, diagnostics, and TraceProjection provide model/operator observability; the owning native projection is separately contracted.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Pillar interoperation > Loom references, backlinks, and search

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Shared Loom/Notes/index actions own their lifecycle events; the Tailor adapter preserves source, correlation, and navigation identities.
The adapter must emit bounded typed interface-unavailable, missing/tombstoned reference, denied-index, backlink, and search diagnostics.
Reference, backlink, and search adaptation owns no application, device, or child-process lifecycle.

risks: Duplicated assets or a Tailor-only knowledge browser would drift from Loom and strand production context.
GUI, backend, agent, replay, and manual projections may drift if they do not consume the same typed authority.
minimum_controls: One typed owner and exact stable ids are required.
Negative, concurrent, cancellation, recovery, and no-context proofs are required where applicable.
No validator PASS/FAIL is inferred from this pre-activation contract.
